#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define pb push_back
using namespace std;
using INT = long long;
const int mod = 1e9+7;
int power(int a, int n, int mod, int ans=1) {
    for(; n; n>>=1, a=(INT)a*a%mod) if(n & 1) ans = (INT)ans * a % mod;
    return ans;
}

const int NN = 1<<7;
int p[NN][NN];
int pro[NN][NN];
int bpt[NN];
INT q[NN][NN];
int n;
int id[NN];
vector<int> vec[NN];
map<pair<int, INT>, int> mp;

inline void add(int &u, int v) {u+=v; if(u>=mod) u -= mod;}

int calc(int now, INT st) {
    if(st == 0) return 0;
    if(now == n) return 1;
    if(mp.find({now, st}) != mp.end()) return mp[{now, st}];
    int ans = 0;
    for(int j=1; j<1<<n; j++) {
        INT nst = 0;
        for(int k=0; k<vec[now].size(); k++) {
            if(not (st & (1LL<<k))) continue;
            int cur = vec[now][k];
            int nxt = j - (j&cur);
            nst |= q[cur][nxt];
        }
        add(ans, (INT)pro[now][j] * calc(now+1, nst) % mod);
    }
    return mp[{now, st}] = ans;
}

            pro[i][j] = 1;
            for(int k=0; k<n; k++) if((j>>k)&1) {
                pro[i][j] = (INT)pro[i][j] * p[i][k] % mod;
            } else pro[i][j] = (INT)pro[i][j] * (mod+1-p[i][k]) % mod;
        }
    }

    for(int i=0; i<1<<n; i++) bpt[i] = bincount(i).sum()
    for(int i=0; i<1<<n; i++) vec[bpt[i]].append(i), id[i] = len(vec[bpt[i]]) - 1
	for(int i=0; i<1<<n; i++) {

        for(int j=0; j<1<<n; j++) q[i][j] = q[i][j&-j] | q[i][j ^ (j&-j)]

	print(calc(0, 1))
